intent: Agent-native Obsidian knowledge vaults with research-backed quality enforcement
vision: Cognitive-science-grounded substrate for personal knowledge bases; closing the gap to an end-to-end LLM knowledge OS (raw → wiki → Q&A → multi-format output → fileback).

features.name: hooks-shellcheck-clean
verification: shellcheck zero errors on all hooks/scripts/*.sh

features.name: frontmatter-lint-clean
verification: all commands/*.md have required YAML keys

features.name: wiki-search-cli
verification: bin/vault-search script exists and is executable
returns plain-text path:line:content hits, paths relative to vault
exit 0 on hits, 1 on miss (fail loud stderr), 2 on misuse/empty vault
tests/test_search_slice.sh enforces anti-cheat: compile → delete raw → hits must come from compiled notes only
documented in README (deferred: slice 2 ships CLI + test; README sweep is a follow-on)
JSON / ranking / semantic search EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE for this slice

features.name: ask-the-wiki-prototype
verification: prompt reads vault MOCs and top-level summaries
returns structured answer with source citations
different from commands/ask.md which queries methodology research

features.name: pdf-ingest-skill
verification: extracts text via pdftotext or equivalent
produces atomic-note drafts for each key concept
creates a source-note with citation metadata

features.name: raw-compile-command
verification: connection weaving ≥2 links/note (requires agent-driven /compile, NOT deterministic replay; P4 forbids fabricating sibling links without semantic grounding)

features.name: copilot-cli-parity
verification: copilot-extension/extension.mjs exists and parses as ESM (node --check)
all 7 vault-tec hooks are wired via the adapter (6 direct + 1 emulated)
vault_tec_preserve_state tool registered as onPreCompact emulation
JS pre-filter gates bash subprocess spawns to writer tools on vault notes
extension loads via extensions_manage inspect (status: running)

features.name: compile-slice-deterministic-witness
verification: commands/compile.md exists with valid frontmatter and contract text
tests/test_compile_slice.sh exits 0 against a fresh temp vault
a *MOC*.md is produced with [[wiki-links]] to all seeds
verify.sh includes this as a gating check (6/6)
